input: Set up a monthly family budget review dinner

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Monthly Family Budget Review Dinner
gold.taskDescription: Plan and establish a recurring monthly dinner where the family gathers to review and discuss the household budget together.

questions.title: Which family members will attend this dinner?
questions.description: Identify who is included: just adults, teenagers, all children, or specific household members.

questions.title: What specific day of the month works best?
questions.description: Determine the recurring day, such as the first Sunday, last Friday, or a fixed date like the 1st or 15th.

questions.title: Will this be at home or at a restaurant?
questions.description: Clarify the venue, whether it is a home-cooked meal, a favourite local restaurant, or rotated each month.

questions.title: What budgeting tool or format do you currently use?
questions.description: Understand whether the family uses a spreadsheet, an app, paper records, or has no system yet.

questions.title: What financial topics must every session cover?
questions.description: Identify the non-negotiable agenda items, such as spending review, savings goals, upcoming bills, or debt tracking.

questions.title: Who leads or facilitates the budget discussion?
questions.description: Determine if one person always runs the meeting, roles rotate, or a neutral approach is preferred.

questions.title: When do you want the first dinner to happen?
questions.description: Pin down a target start date so the plan has a concrete launch point to work backward from.
